You show Gwylan the mining helmet.

"These used to be more common, back when the mines were still open," <<he>> says. "The official story of why it was shut down was because of flooding, but I think they found something down there," <<he>> muses. "So why did the shop show this to you?"
You tell <<him>> about your slavery in the mine, and how you incited a rebellion and put them out of commission.

"They had us mining for these." You pull out a $mine.heldGem. <<His>> eyes go wide. Before you can react, <<he>> immediately rips it out of your hand, runs to the door, and chucks it as far as <<he>> can. <<He>> relaxes and walks back to you.
"Now, where were we?" <<He>> quickly notices your confusion. "Oh! I'm sorry <<pcpetname "Gwylan">>. Those things are quite dangerous, I wouldn't recommend coming into contact with them again."

"That was a good thing you did, fighting back," <<he>> says. "People are weak alone, but together, they become stronger." Your thoughts turn to the orphanage. "I've suspected that the mines had resumed operation, I'm glad you stopped it."
